technology.title: AI Data Centres Are Hoarding the World's Memory Chips. Your Next Laptop Will Pay the Price.

India's own consumer electronics market and burgeoning gaming industry are also hit. Micron's Gujarat fab, led by Sanjay Mehrotra, is focused on HBM for AI, not consumer DRAM — underscoring the supply trade-off.
